column1: # Reading the worker heartbeat <sub>/heartbeats/<имя> by the form and the outcomes of the family (the observation contract «Form»; Platform/03-worker/data/heartbeats.schema.json,

column5: note
a heartbeat by the form — readable by all, no items to skip
not a JSON object — the whole heartbeat is unreadable
the required instance is absent — the whole heartbeat is unreadable
status not a list — the whole heartbeat is unreadable, and GET /{rows} does not read the items
worker ≠ the name in the key (w-1) — the whole heartbeat is unreadable (the prose rule P/03.4 Н1.1, the outcome «the whole object»)
an item without phase — GET /{rows} skips item 1, the others — the heartbeat as unreadable
epoch not a whole number — the item is not by the form
phase sealed with epoch and observed_revision — the item is not by the form (W03-G02)
phase unreadable with why, without epoch — the item is by the form (W03-G05)
id not by the grammar of a unit id — the item is not by the form
build not a string — the heartbeat is readable, the outcome of the field build
schema 0 and pending_writes −1 — the heartbeat is readable, the outcomes of the fields schema and pending_writes
the path "" before /status: the whole heartbeat is unreadable — nobody reads the items, and GET /{rows} neither
an exponent in the time lexeme ts (1e0) — the time is not by the form (codec.tsv time, the reader) — the whole heartbeat is unreadable
started 1e-400 — an exponent: not by the form, though in binary64 it is 0 — the whole heartbeat is unreadable
previous_hb -0 — a sign: the time is not by the form — the whole heartbeat is unreadable
freeing.v1 100.0 — whole by the exact decimal value of the lexeme (100) — readable
freeing.v1 100.00000000000000001 — the exact decimal value is not whole (in binary64 it would be 100) — the whole heartbeat is unreadable (freeing has no field outcome)
pending_writes 1.0 — whole: only a whole number — the outcome of the field pending_writes, the heartbeat is readable
